scene: The glowing green screen tracks three departing transit routes across pixelated skies.
picture: A round green radar console fills the frame. On the screen, miniature glowing icons reveal three destinations: on the far left, a snowy tram depot route; in the centre, a deep-sea harbor trail; on the right, floating balloon trajectories. Three labelled departure doors line the brass console casing.
shown: a frosted gate marked Snow Globe Works standing ready on the far left
a glowing harbor-bound gangway ticket stall waiting in the middle left
a wicker balloon basket tethered beside an open launch bay on the far right
